method: Production Edge; fresh isolated context per viewport; deviceScaleFactor 1. Mobile viewport/touch uses the same desktop CPU/GPU. Feedback latency begins at the actual click event and ends two RAF callbacks after the expected feedback enters the DOM, approximating a renderable frame, not a physical display paint measurement. No fixed FPS acceptance threshold is asserted. Stress mode applies CDP Fast 3G (1.6 Mbps download, 0.75 Mbps upload, 150 ms latency) and CPU 4× slowdown on the same desktop GPU. It verifies a real persisted Math answer while the 3D scene is still loading; this is emulation, not a phone or live-network acceptance run.
